# Pricing, cost assumptions and break-even (PROJECTION)

Per-term subscription per centre (agreed in the plan revision); first term free as a pilot.

| Tier | Price | Period | Includes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pilot | 0 EGP | per term 4 months | All features for one term; Setup help from the founder |
| Centre | 1,500 EGP | per term 4 months | Unlimited sessions and teachers; CSV export; Support during working hours |

**Rationale (ASSUMPTION):** EGP 1,500 per term is an ASSUMPTION to test in owner interviews: low enough for a small centre's owner to decide alone, and enough that a handful of paying centres would cover the assumed monthly costs. It must be validated before any real sale.

## Cost assumptions
| Item | Amount | Kind | Class | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hosting and domain | 100 EGP | fixed monthly | ASSUMPTION | Annual cost spread monthly; prices not retrieved. |
| Mobile data and transport for support | 400 EGP | fixed monthly | ASSUMPTION | Rough assumption. |
| Onboarding visit per new centre | 150 EGP | variable per sale | ASSUMPTION | Transport for one visit. |
| Leaflets and setup | 800 EGP | one time | ASSUMPTION | Rough assumption. |

## Break-even (computed in code from the assumptions above)
Break-even at **2 paying customers** (monthly-equivalent price 375.0 EGP).

| Paying customers | Monthly revenue | Monthly net | Months to recover one-time costs |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 1,875 | 1,188 | 1 |
| 10 | 3,750 | 2,875 | 1 |
| 20 | 7,500 | 6,250 | 1 |
| 40 | 15,000 | 13,000 | 1 |

Projection computed from ASSUMPTION inputs. Not a forecast and not a promise of income.

## Compliance review checklist
- [ ] Ask a lawyer whether Egypt's personal data protection law applies to the data handled — Session records can include student names.
- [ ] Register the business activity before taking any real payment — Required before invoicing customers.
- [ ] Have a lawyer review the draft terms, privacy and refund policies — They are drafts, not legal advice.
- [ ] Avoid storing student names during the pilot where possible — Reduces personal-data risk.
- [ ] Choose a payment method only after legal review — No payment method is connected in Mate.
